title: Exploiting Task-Level Vulnerabilities: An Automatic Jailbreak Attack and Defense Benchmarking for LLMs
motivation: 现有越狱攻击依赖特定prompt或token，易被重对齐修补，需挖掘更深层的任务级漏洞
problem_framing: 将恶意任务分解为无害子任务链式执行，绕过LLM防御机制
key_insight: 无害与恶意任务共享底层知识（如修复与利用漏洞都需识别漏洞），通过知识分解可规避风险判断
method_signature: KDA知识分解越狱攻击 + 多风险层级防御基准
evaluation_criteria: 攻击成功率(ASR)、响应信息丰富度、防御有效性区分度
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 分解树可能指数级膨胀，查询开销过大
evidence_for_taste: rendering them susceptible to countermeasures such as realignments
does not rely on any specific prompts or tokens
significantly greater resilience against re-alignment defenses
this multi-query integration significantly enhances the granularity
moderately harmful tasks have been largely overlooked
thinking_moves: 从对抗视角追问补丁式防御的充分性
识别无害与恶意任务的知识重叠结构
将单查询攻击扩展为多子任务聚合框架
利用LLM对知识性问题的响应偏好隐藏恶意意图
